lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，找那些东西。
lines.en: I walk along the walls, hunting them.

lines.zh: 它们藏在暗处，我就去暗处。
lines.en: They hide in the dark, so I go to the dark.
The floor doesn't creak when I walk.
I'm not here for the living.

lines.zh: 这一带有味道，是那些东西的。
lines.en: There's a smell here. Theirs.

lines.zh: 我走过去，它们就该跑了。
lines.en: I walk over. They should be running.

lines.zh: 墙上只有我的影子在动。
lines.en: Only my shadow moves on the wall.
After a stretch I stop and listen.
They don't speak, but they move.
I head for the darker end.
I pass you by without looking.
My old cloth trails on the ground.
I stand and let them move first.
Dust settles on my golden shell.
There's another smell here.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着一个角落。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on a corner.
They know I'm here too.
The light flickered and I shifted.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，谁看了都怕。
lines.en: Anyone would fear this shape of mine.

lines.zh: 可我这次不是冲你来的。
lines.en: This time I'm not here for you.

lines.zh: 安静一会儿，它们就会露头。
lines.en: Be still a while and they'll show themselves.
My fingers curl slowly.
Stand still. I'm not after you.
I'm watching somewhere else.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，跟它们不一样。
lines.en: Your smell is different from theirs.

lines.zh: 走开，别挡在我和它中间。
lines.en: Move. Don't stand between me and it.

lines.zh: 你看见那边的东西了吗？
lines.en: Did you see the thing over there?

lines.zh: 我转头，只是确认你没威胁。
lines.en: I turn my head only to confirm you're no threat.
Follow me and I disappear.

lines.zh: 你要是也怕它，就躲远点。
lines.en: If you fear it too, stay back.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，吓人，但不咬你。
lines.en: This face frightens, but it won't bite you.
Now, step aside.

lines.zh: 这一下，打在我的旧壳上。
lines.en: That struck my old shell.

lines.zh: 我没退，我还有事没做完。
lines.en: I didn't retreat. My work isn't done.
The cloth tore; the metal shows.
I brace on the wall. I can't catch breath.
You're hitting the wrong thing.
Something came loose. I can still move.
This kind of pain, I don't fear.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我还得去找它。
lines.en: After this, I still have to find it.
You've delayed me.
Move. I can still walk.
I don't eat. Put it away.

lines.zh: 那东西对你有用，对我没用。
lines.en: That's useful to you, not to me.
I sniff it. Not interested.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着它，会招来东西。
lines.en: Holding that will draw things to you.
I push it back toward you.
Don't share with me.
I'd rather catch that one over there.
Step back. I'm going through.
Is this thing alive?
What you're holding is swaying.
One bump and you stepped back.
I didn't stop. I just went around.
Don't hold me. I have work.
There's light in the gap you block.
This old frame is hard to hit.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，我没看你。
lines.en: We brushed past. I didn't look.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，示意你让。
lines.en: I raise a hand for you to move.
The floor creaked and I stopped.
You press to the wall and it goes cold.
Touch me and your hand turns cold.
I've no mind for that.
If you want to come close, come close.
My hands are cold. Don't hold them long.
Few living things in this building.
Company isn't bad.
When I'm done, I'll come back.
Stay hidden. Don't come out.
I can't promise to protect you.

lines.zh: 天亮之后，我不记得这些。
lines.en: After dawn, I won't remember this.
Close the door when you go.
This suit of mine has gone yellow.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，塞进墙上的缝。
lines.en: I pick it up and shove it into a crack in the wall.
I set it down and move on.

lines.zh: 这东西上面有它们的味道。
lines.en: This has their smell on it.
I squeeze it. Hard.
For you. Take it.
I toss it aside.
There's more on the ground.

lines.zh: 我一只脚踩住，免得滚走。
lines.en: I pin it with a foot so it won't roll.
Keep it safe. Don't drop it in the corridor.
It moved. I saw it.
I've fixed on that spot.
This is my work.

lines.zh: 这是我俩的事，你别插手。
lines.en: This is between us. Don't interfere.
I walk toward the corner.
The end of the corridor is a dead end.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里的东西，都得清掉。
lines.en: Everything in this building must be cleared.
I sit up straight.
It's trying to hide in the wall.
Running now is too late.

lines.zh: 那边的墙缝里，有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves in that crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 它的味道很旧，像放了很久。
lines.en: Its smell is old, like something left out.
I turn to face it squarely.

lines.zh: 这一只跑得比上一只快。
lines.en: This one runs faster than the last.
It's hiding under the shelving.

lines.zh: 我走过去，它就没地方躲了。
lines.en: I walk over, and it has nowhere to hide.
I watch it, step by step.
It goes left; I block left.

lines.zh: 我不用喊，它听得见脚步。
lines.en: No need to shout. It hears my steps.

lines.zh: 这个角落只有一条出路。
lines.en: This corner has one way out.
I raise a hand and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 它在找我的破绽，我没有。
lines.en: It's looking for a gap. I have none.
It's backing away. Not far to go.
I'm slow, but I don't stop.
That sound is far away; not my concern.
Dust has settled on my yellow suit.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把它往墙角赶。
lines.en: Step by step, I drive it into the corner.
It stops suddenly and looks back at me.

lines.zh: 我也停住，看它想做什么。
lines.en: I stop too, to see what it will do.

lines.zh: 它想从上面跳过去，我抬手。
lines.en: It tries to leap over. I raise a hand.

lines.zh: 它退到楼梯口，那是个死路。
lines.en: It backs to the stairwell. A dead end.
I won't chase. It'll come to me.

lines.zh: 这个走廊太窄，它转不了身。
lines.en: The corridor is too narrow for it to turn.
I lower my head and see its legs clearly.
It's panting. I'm not tired.
Next time it won't slip away.
One hand down and it's pinned.
That's enough to scatter it.
I don't shout. I don't stop.
It claws at me. Iron doesn't yield.
I slam it into the floor.
After this, there's nothing left.

lines.zh: 我的力气，用在它们身上。
lines.en: My strength goes into them.
Get back. Don't get splashed.

lines.zh: 它还在动，那我再来一下。
lines.en: It's still moving. Once more.
This floor is cleared.

lines.zh: 我一下子压下去，它扁了。
lines.en: I press down and it flattens.
It bites my finger. It can't.
I lift it off the ground.

lines.zh: 我一手按住，另一手砸下。
lines.en: One hand pins it; the other comes down.

lines.zh: 它挣得很厉害，力气不小。
lines.en: It struggles hard. Stronger than it looks.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我给它的结论。
lines.en: This blow is my verdict on it.
It came apart. A little is left on the floor.
I lift a foot and bring it down.
Their bones are soft.

lines.zh: 我把它摔到墙上，声音很闷。
lines.en: I hurl it at the wall. A dull sound.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，灯闪了一下。
lines.en: The light flickered when I appeared.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里有东西，我来了。
lines.en: There's something in this building. I've come.
I rise slowly, joints crackling.
My direction is inward.
Dust falls from the old cloth.
I straighten and look around.
They don't know I've arrived.

lines.zh: 不用怕我，我今天有别的事。
lines.en: Don't fear me. I have other business today.
The door closed itself, and I was there.
I lift a foot. The first step is heavy.
I'll clear this floor.
All of you, quiet. I can hear.
Fire caught me; my cloth is burning.

lines.zh: 我掉下来，落地时砸出声音。
lines.en: I fell, and the landing made a sound.

lines.zh: 水进了壳里，我的动作变慢。
lines.en: Water got inside; my movements slow.

lines.zh: 炸得我退了两步，站住了。
lines.en: The blast pushed me back two steps. I held.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的关节里。
lines.en: Something's jammed in a joint.
That light made me sway.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我也撑不了太久。
lines.en: I don't hunger, but I won't last forever either.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I froze for an instant.

lines.zh: 这里没有地板，我什么都踩不到。
lines.en: No floor here. Nothing to stand on.
